rows.text: La curva caratteristica mette in relazione la coppia erogata con il numero di giri del motore, non con il peso del veicolo.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: Nella curva caratteristica tipica la coppia cresce con i giri fino a un massimo, poi diminuisce; non segue il minimo descritto.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: La coppia è il prodotto della forza per il suo braccio perpendicolare rispetto all’asse, non la loro somma.
evidence: https://openstax.org/books/physics/pages/6-3-rotational-motion, sezione Torque: τ = rF sin θ.

rows.text: La curva di potenza mostra la potenza erogata ai diversi regimi del motore, non la coppia rispetto alle dimensioni del veicolo.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: Nella curva caratteristica tipica la potenza cresce con il regime fino a un massimo e poi cala; il punto preciso dipende dal motore.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: La curva permette di confrontare la potenza disponibile ai diversi regimi di rotazione del motore.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: Il quiz indica FALSO. La curva di coppia non basta a individuare il consumo massimo: a uno stesso regime il consumo cambia anche con il carico. Per confrontare i consumi occorre la mappa del motore e precisare come sono misurati.
evidence: US DOE Co-Optima webinar https://www.energy.gov/cmei/fuels/text-version-co-optima-webinar-how-can-co-optimized-fuels-and-spark-ignition-engines — efficiency map depends on speed and load, with light-duty spark-ignition research examples. It does not establish the quiz’s claimed coincidence for an unspecified engine/load or a model-specific near-peak optimum.

NREL vehicle choice and applied analysis https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/medium-and-heavy-duty-vehicle-choice-modeling-and-applied-analysis — fuel-rate maps relate operation to speed and torque; distinguish fuel rate from efficiency. Printed answer retained without asserting a demonstrated near-peak efficiency optimum.

rows.text: La curva di potenza tipica sale fino a un massimo e poi scende, non raggiunge prima un minimo come affermato.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: Il quiz indica VERO, ma la curva di coppia da sola non dimostra dove sia il rendimento massimo. La mappa di rendimento dipende da regime e carico: per verificare la coincidenza indicata occorrono i dati del motore nelle condizioni considerate.
evidence: US DOE Co-Optima webinar https://www.energy.gov/cmei/fuels/text-version-co-optima-webinar-how-can-co-optimized-fuels-and-spark-ignition-engines — efficiency map depends on speed and load, with light-duty spark-ignition research examples. It does not establish the quiz’s claimed coincidence for an unspecified engine/load or a model-specific near-peak optimum.

NREL vehicle choice and applied analysis https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/medium-and-heavy-duty-vehicle-choice-modeling-and-applied-analysis — fuel-rate maps relate operation to speed and torque; distinguish fuel rate from efficiency. Printed answer retained without asserting a demonstrated near-peak efficiency optimum.

rows.text: Nella curva caratteristica tipica la coppia aumenta fino a un massimo e poi diminuisce ai regimi più elevati.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: I due massimi non coincidono necessariamente: la potenza dipende sia dalla coppia sia dalla velocità di rotazione e può continuare a crescere dopo il picco di coppia.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

OpenStax, University Physics Vol. 1, §10.8, https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/10-8-work-and-power-for-rotational-motion: rotational power equals torque times angular velocity.

rows.text: Le curve mostrano come coppia e potenza disponibili cambiano con il regime, descrivendo caratteristiche utili del motore.
evidence: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

rows.text: Tenere sempre il motore al massimo dei giri non è una regola per ridurre le emissioni. Una guida efficiente usa un rapporto e un regime adatti alle condizioni.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Efficient Driving: A Rapid Evidence Assessment, pp. 65–66, https://www.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/509972/efficient-driving-rapid-evidence-assessment.pdf: reported 2,000 versus 3,000 rpm upshifts reduced NO in one older study but increased CO and HC; pollutant effects differ and evidence is limited.

TNO, Analysis of the CO2 emissions of light-duty vehicles, §3.2.5.5, https://climate.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2016-11/analysis_ldv_co2_emissions_en.pdf: gear changes and engine speed affect fuel consumption; eco-driving includes early upshifts to keep engine speed low.

rows.text: Un deflettore ben adattato sopra la cabina indirizza l’aria verso la parte superiore del carico e riduce la resistenza aerodinamica del complesso.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/conserve/equipment, Aerodynamic Equipment: gli airfoil dirigono l’aria sopra la cabina e riducono la resistenza.
https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P1000S9O.TXT, Improved Aerodynamics: deflettori sul tetto tra i dispositivi aerodinamici dei trattori.

rows.text: La resistenza cresce approssimativamente con il quadrato della velocità rispetto all’aria: un aumento di velocità produce quindi un aumento più che proporzionale della forza.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: A parità di coefficiente, densità e velocità relativa all’aria, aumentando l’area frontale aumenta proporzionalmente la forza resistente.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: Il fondo bagnato riguarda il contatto degli pneumatici con la strada; la resistenza aerodinamica dipende invece dal flusso d’aria attorno al veicolo.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: La velocità conta: a parità delle altre condizioni, la forza aerodinamica cresce con il quadrato della velocità rispetto all’aria.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: Un carico eccessivo richiede più energia per muovere il veicolo e può aumentare il carburante consumato e le emissioni; l’effetto sui singoli inquinanti dipende dalle condizioni.
evidence: US EPA, Vehicle Weight and CO2 Emissions, https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P10191S7.TXT: greater vehicle weight requires more energy and increases CO2 other conditions equal.

US EPA HERO, Huang et al. (2006), https://hero.epa.gov/reference/1639577/: on-road tests of two diesel trucks found higher NOx and fuel-consumption factors with load; individual CO and HC results varied.

rows.text: Il coefficiente aerodinamico descrive l’effetto della forma e del flusso d’aria, non dipende direttamente dal peso del veicolo.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-coefficient/, definizione di Cd e dipendenza da forma, inclinazione e condizioni del flusso.

rows.text: Vincere la resistenza dell’aria richiede energia al motore: ridurla può quindi migliorare il consumo di carburante.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/conserve/equipment, Aerodynamic Equipment: meno resistenza riduce il carico sul motore e migliora il risparmio di carburante.

rows.text: La relazione è diretta, non inversa: a parità delle altre condizioni una maggiore area frontale produce maggiore resistenza.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: La forza aerodinamica dipende da velocità relativa all’aria, area, densità e coefficiente, non è direttamente proporzionale alla potenza massima del motore.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: A parità delle altre condizioni la forza resistente cresce con il quadrato della velocità relativa all’aria: se questa raddoppia, la forza quadruplica.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

rows.text: La forza aerodinamica non è direttamente proporzionale al peso: dipende invece da area, forma, aria e velocità relativa.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-equation/, equazione D = Cd × ρ × V² × A / 2: area frontale, velocità relativa all’aria e coefficiente determinano la resistenza.

issues.reason: The printed VERO asserts coincidence of the rpm near maximum torque with maximum efficiency for internal-combustion engines without specifying engine, load or efficiency measure. Accessible sources support favorable efficiency in some regions, but do not establish that coincidence generally; engine efficiency varies with both speed and load. Independent source adjudication is needed before supplying the claimed maximum.
checked_sources: Robert Bosch GmbH, Gasoline-engine management: Basics and components, p. 7, “Power output and torque”, fig. 1, https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/public-informations/petitions/1539828/download-documents?artifactId=UJEpDOFJ-6vQkdEVveZ9_ls3MAYETAk160ZIPyF9DS8uYS08NL8ygDY: typical manifold-injection gasoline engine curves plot torque and power against rpm; torque rises to a maximum and falls; power rises to a maximum and then falls in the figure, at a higher rpm than peak torque.

TNO, 02.OR.VM.004.1/HVDB (2002), appendix A.3/4, https://publications.tno.nl/publication/34613582/N0rnml/02.OR.VM.004.1-HVDB.pdf: typical petrol and diesel maps show brake-specific fuel consumption varying with speed and load, with a minimum region at intermediate speed and high load.

US Department of Energy, Co-Optima webinar, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/fuels/text-version-co-optima-webinar-how-can-co-optimized-fuels-and-spark-ignition-engines: engine efficiency changes substantially with speed and load; some highest efficiencies occur at low speeds and high loads.
